Kick now bound to X on a joypad

Roll now bound to B on a joypad
Hooked up Music toggle
Hooked up Mouse inversion
Hooked up Vsync toggle
Hooked up Window toggle

Fixed Chopper on Level 4 so it actually blows up.

notes.title: Patch 24
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35457339/03f87dd7aa92e06a078b3b999fbd7fb781f61ed7.jpg

Improvements to the cover in the first hangar on level 3

notes.title: Patch 23
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35457339/489f9129a64ccd03ae35e961e14df04de99fc31d.jpg

Yet again a short-looking set of patch notes for SOOOOO much work!


Level 3 should now be working and completable. Lots of stuff isn't finished tho - the aliens won't follow and you can't enter the UFO. This should be finished tomorrow.
You can now fly the UFO on Level 4 and destroy Area 51!
Pause menu exists and works. None of the options are hooked up yet, but this should happen tomorrow.


Apologies for the silence over the weekend, but just occasionally I have Socialise. Should be full steam ahead until we leave Early Access now!

notes.title: Patch 22
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35457339/a5ab55a88ad849d56cbd2db2b3099da0227ca01e.jpg


Lots of work fixing up shared assets between level 2 and level 4. Level 2 should now work properly again.
Fixed a large number of collidable objects to work with the new camera code.
Level 4 should be available today, work permitting.

notes.title: Patch 21
notes.notes:
A second iteration on the camera intra-collision code. Hopefully this means a responsive camera and no jittering and no clipping. Did I get it right?
Loads more work on Level 4. Bomb code should be implemented tomorrow

notes.title: Patch #20
notes.notes:
Lots of work on Level 3 - on this level you will take out lots of American military hardware, before rescuing the aliens and stealing a UFO
New Camera system. This should alleviate the complaints regarding 'floaty' cameras. I'd say 'feedback welcome', but apparently I'm not getting any anymore :-(
Added more destructable targets for Level 4

notes.title: Patch 19
notes.notes:
Quit option works on the main menu.
Pause menu - coming soon!
Implemented basic camera collision, so the camera attempts to move out of colliding areas. It's not perfect, but it's the best I can do in the time possible. Please let me know what you think!
Level 2 should now be completable
Smoke Grenades should no longer leave behind audio after timing out.
Further Tweaks to level 1 patrol routes
Reworked Friendly spawn on Level 2, so the runners will flood in from a seperate warehouse. Use them as cover!

notes.title: Patch 18
notes.notes:
Fixed more collision issues on Level 1. Gnashed and wailed.
Fixed Force field rendering.
Substantial improvements to guard patrol routes on Level 2

notes.title: Patch #17
notes.notes:
Not many notes, but lots of work :(


Fixed a number of new collision issues on level 1
Replaced the UFO UI

notes.title: Patch #16
notes.notes:
Fixed Gnome transformation Smoke on level 2
A huge number of changes to Level 2 for playability, improving cover, patrol routes, performance, audio and navigation.
Returning to titlescreen is no longer silent.

notes.notes:
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/8e39eb8ddd36048e6699b1b93d7cef6a.mp4[/video]

Fixed Aliens occasonally pathing underground

Added unique icon to Alien holding

notes.title: Patch 0.0014
notes.notes:
And here we are - patch 14, 6 days after release and still going strong!


Collecting a Gnome causes you to turn into a Gnome for 5-20 seconds. (depends on Difficulty)
Collect all Gnomes for permenant Gnomage!
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/16287045f373893ac25a1d5feafc3588.mp4[/video]

notes.title: Patch 0.00013
notes.notes:
Fixed glass in Level 2
Fixed powerups being beneath the floor on Level 2
Fixed a number of objects not having collision on Level 2
Fixed audio disappearing when dying when flying the UFO 
Fixed Drop-Off on Level 2. Not all Aliens are collectable yet.

notes.title: Patch 0.0012
notes.notes:
Fixed many hundreds of poorly-performing objects on Level 2 - framerate++!
Fixed loads of collision errors on Level 2
Fixed many spawn locations of powerups on Level 2
Added placeholder MOTD system
Tweaked Level 2 lights to help identify areas differently
Gnomes are a little brighter
Improved Occlusion on Level 2

notes.title: Patch 0.0011
notes.notes:
Fixed returning to the main menu having no mouse cursor.
Added Beam rendering to UFO Heat Ray attack.
If the Beam overheats, you need to wait for it to cool before using. This replaces the previous 'fire for 1 frame, wait for 1 frame' code.
Tweaked UFO constraint zone a bit. There's nothing out there. Stop looking.

notes.title: Patch 0.0010
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35457339/598d705d17fbff6772657404b2c483a5dd8de3ed.png

Patch 10!


Added Level 2 (Warehouse/Lab)
Added Level 4 (Daytime Base Escape)
These levels are PREVIEWS and are not currently completable. Feedback wanted!
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/577c3d6b7a2c33a9cd823872315a6d5e.mp4[/video]
Added UFO combat on Level 4
Added EMP Blasts
Added HeatRay
Added AA Missiles
Converted a huge number of objects to be destructableCreated placeholder ui for UFO flight
Runners will now exit level 4.
Added a complete progression system for loading and saving, and recording your best times.
Added placeholder main menu. You can change your mind on the difficulty after the load's complete, as I'm nice like that.

notes.title: Patch 0.0009
notes.notes:
Increased Gnome Bonus to 50k per Gnome, to offset the increased scoring elsewhere
Added a first-pass completion sequence for when you win.
Added the first-pass of Levels
Fixed an issue where sometimes Guards couldn't target you
Fixed an issue where your character would sit down for no reason.
Fixed a rendering issue with the stamina bar
Added rendering data for Level 2.  Think levels should be released as soon as they exist? https://steamcommunity.com/app/630490/discussions/0/3140616601472393267/

notes.title: Patch 0.0008
notes.notes:
Guards should no longer fail to track you quite so easily. It's possible they're actually a little too 'Terminator' in this patch - feedback wanted!
Added animations for collecting items and dropping off. This means you can't sprint past dangerous items and ignore the guards anymore - timing your collection becomes more important now.
You can no longer interact with anything whilst rolling (this including picking stuff up)
Improved Guard's ability to pivot and aim whilst not moving.
Fire audio is no longer a point source

notes.title: Patch 0.0007
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where rolling and sprinting at the same time would get you stuck
Improvements to performance of vis culling
Fix to Guard rendering

notes.title: Patch 0.0006
notes.notes:
Added Stamina. Rolling and Sprinting uses Stamina. Stamina recovers over time, and recovers twice as fast if Crouching.


It's now literally too hot to stay in my house, so I'm going somewhere air-conditioned, and will continue work after the sun's gone down. 

Feedback always gratefully received.

notes.title: Patch 0.0005
notes.notes:
Using a Medkit at full health will now empty your hand.
Added Crouch on Left Control. This makes you harder to detect, and you're safe behind 1 metre tall obstacles.
Added Sprint on Left Shift (animation is placeholder). This makes you move faster, but drains your stamina bar.
Reworked the entrance to the Base to improve occlusion and performance.
Fixed an issue where people with low-end PCs optimistically chose a high detail and the LOD system would panic.


Remember - I don't know what you think needs to be fixed unless you tell me!

notes.title: Patch 0.0004
notes.notes:
Added further event triggers - the friendlies can now disable the streetlights and masts by turning off the generators.
Fixed Bus Smoke
Fire is no longer silent
Added audio to Smoke Grenades
Fixed dozens of small geometry errors
Keemstar's hat is no longer made of shiny
Added 3 difficulties - EzMode, Regular and GitGud. This will also halve or double your score.
Fixed some LOD popping issues. You don't need to run on 'Potato' unless you've got a really crap PC...
Added some auto-balancing FPS code, so the game should be always playable on low-spec rigs and also the detail will turn up automatically if your PC is capable.

notes.title: Patch 0.0003
notes.notes:
Scaled Ambient Occlusion by detail setting, increasing performance
Set up Q/LMB for Primary Use and E/RMB for Secondary Use, rebindable in the Launcher
Removed SlowmoTime from (T)
Removed Death key (oops)
Added Smoke Grenades - Guards are unable to target through them, tho they can blind fire into them. Lasts 30 seconds and follows camera forwards, not character forward.
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/177e9b9740ba74866ed3a5456779338e.mp4[/video]
Large boost to loading times!
More Gear added outside the base, allowing you to gear up before entering the fight.

notes.title: Patch 0.0002
notes.notes:
Added usable items - Q or LMB for left hand use and E or RMB for right hand use.
Fixed issues where Gnomes weren't always collectable
Fixed issue where player didn't always heal after dropping an Alien off
Fixed issue where guards couldn't shoot the player when standing on sloped ground.
Added instant-use FieldKits that give 50 HP when touched
Added delay-use MedKits that give 25 HP when used. They take up a hand to carry.
Added Cloak. You cannot be targetted by guards when active, and any current guards will immediately drop you as a target. Uses up a hand to carry.

[video]https://i.gyazo.com/14fadf95c0a07523c18b05134cfcbab7.mp4[/video]

Added Body armour. This effectively gives 100 extra health, and allows you to break the 100% health barrier. Your health bar will be green when the armour is active.
Fixed some 2d sound issues
Added a random powerup system - MedKits, FieldKits and Body Armour will now spawn randomly. Prefer a fixed setup over randomness? Let me know!
Added 20 random powerups throughout the level. Too easy now?

notes.title: Patch 0.001 out now
notes.notes:
Fixed score calculation and improved time readout
Dying no longer completely covers the floor in 3,000 gallons of blood
Player can no longer end up with a negative score
Guards can no longer shoot eachother. Oops.
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/d0af7cc481fb762520367d975a3e6126.mp4[/video]
Optimisation to navmesh generation to speed up pathfinding time
Added Gnome Bonus! Find gnomes to boost your score. There's 20 in total, each worth 5,000 points.
